gaps.info: Clinical assessment of lesion pigmentation (e.g., brown/black macules/papules) and surface morphology (e.g., velvety vs. verrucous)
gaps.discriminates: Classic bowenoid papulosis (often pigmented, flat-to-papular) vs. verrucous carcinoma *in situ* (more exophytic, keratotic) or Bowen disease (usually solitary, sun-damaged skin)

gaps.info: Dermoscopic features or reflectance confocal microscopy findings
gaps.discriminates: HPV-associated dysplasia (e.g., honeycomb pattern disruption, atypical honeycomb, pagetoid cells) vs. inflammatory or nevoid mimics
